decisions.reason: As a multi-model laser workstation line built on the firm's established laser offer and launched only in 2023, it represents real development investment and any early weakness can still be read as a ramp-up effect, so writing it off after one year is unlikely.

The thermal inkjet printer sits close to the core portfolio, has its own website page as a public commitment, and supports the single-source strategy and consumables revenue, so management will persist with it.

The piezo inkjet printer was developed in-house, is presented publicly on its own page, and is central to matching technologies to surfaces, so dropping it after one year would expose the investment as a mistake while early results can still be attributed to temporary causes.
